// REQ: LANG-1411 LANG-1412
using System;

/* Block comment */
variant Shape {
  | Circle { r : double }
  | Rect { w : double; h : double }
}

module Program {
  Main() : void {
    def name = "world";
    mutable count = 0x1F;
    match (Shape.Circle(1.5)) {
      | Shape.Circle(r) => Console.WriteLine($"Hello, $name! $(r * r)")
      | _ => ()
    }
    when (count > 0) count--;
  }
}
